title: Houses and renovations, Brisbane: decks and pergolas
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Timber deck at the back of a house
swms.task: Build a timber deck 2.5 m above the ground at the back of a house, digging post holes and concreting the posts, and cutting timber with a drop saw.

facts.fallControl: The deck frame is built from the ground and from a mobile scaffold with guardrails; no one works on the open joists near the edge until the decking is laid and temporary edge protection is fixed.
facts.controlsConsidered: Edge protection and scaffolds were considered first for every task, and an elevating work platform where they cannot be fixed.

steps: Set out and dig post holes
